```{r}
source("R/07_add_light_treatment.R")

data_full <- readRDS('data/data_full.rds')

data_env <- data_env %>%
  left_join(
    lighting %>% select(date, color, intensity, block),
    by = "date"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    color     = if_else(year %in% c(2021, 2023) & is.na(color), "R", color),
    intensity = if_else(year %in% c(2021, 2023) & is.na(intensity), 75, intensity),
    block     = if_else(year %in% c(2021, 2023), "zero", block),
    color     = factor(color),
    site      = factor(site),
    block     = factor(block)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(intensity), !is.na(color))

data_env <- data_env %>%
  mutate(
    control_year     = year %in% c(2021, 2023),
    switching_interval = case_when(
      control_year        ~ "control",
      block == "three"    ~ "three",
      block == "seven"    ~ "seven"
    ),
    switching_interval = factor(switching_interval,
                                levels = c("seven", "three", "control"))
  )
```

```{r}
sky_brightness <- read.csv("output/sky_brightness_measurements.csv") %>%
  mutate(brightness_imputed = FALSE)

# CRNR1 and DALO1 have no sky photos. Each measured site's photos come from the
# nearest distance-project site (all within ~110 m), so the missing two take the
# value of their nearest photographed site by the same rule:
#   CRNR1 -> GRTE01 (223 m), the photos used for SHLA1
#   DALO1 -> GRTE17 (374 m), the photos used for AMLA1
brightness_proxy <- c(CRNR1 = "SHLA1", DALO1 = "AMLA1")
sky_brightness <- bind_rows(
  sky_brightness,
  sky_brightness %>%
    filter(site %in% brightness_proxy) %>%
    mutate(site = names(brightness_proxy)[match(site, brightness_proxy)],
           brightness_imputed = TRUE)
)

data_env <- data_env %>%
  left_join(sky_brightness, by = "site") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(mean_brightness_site),
    !species %in% c("HiF", "Myca", "Myth", "Myse", "Labo", "Coto", "Anpa")
  )

```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# ── SPECIES MODELS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# =============================================================================
 
species_list <- unique(data_env$species)
cat("Fitting models for", length(species_list), "species...\n")
 
sp_formula <- detections ~ jd + I(jd^2) + mean_phase + pct_nonforest +
  intensity * color + mean_brightness_site + switching_interval + (1|year) + (1 | site)
 
fit_sp <- function(dat, sp) {
  # Attempt 1: default nlminb
  mod <- tryCatch(
    glmmTMB(sp_formula, family = nbinom2, data = dat),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  # Attempt 2: BFGS if Hessian not positive-definite
  if (is.null(mod) || !isTRUE(mod$sdr$pdHess)) {
    mod <- tryCatch(
      glmmTMB(sp_formula, family = nbinom2, data = dat,
              control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim,
                                       optArgs   = list(method = "BFGS"))),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  }
  if (is.null(mod) || !isTRUE(mod$sdr$pdHess))
    cat("  WARNING:", sp, "— convergence uncertain after both optimizers\n")
  mod
}
 
sp_models <- list()
 
for (sp in species_list) {
  dat_sp <- data_env |> filter(species == sp)
 
  if (sum(dat_sp$detections) < 30 | nrow(dat_sp) < 20) {
    cat("  Skipping", sp, "— insufficient data\n")
    next
  }
 
  cat("  Fitting:", sp, "\n")
  sp_models[[sp]] <- fit_sp(dat_sp, sp)
}
 
sp_models <- sp_models[!sapply(sp_models, is.null)]
cat("Successfully fit:", paste(names(sp_models), collapse = ", "), "\n")

```

```{r}
# ── Extract emmeans summaries for all species ─────────────────────────────────
extract_color_intensity <- function(mod, sp_name) {
  tryCatch(
    as.data.frame(emmeans(mod, ~ color | intensity,
                          at = list(intensity = c(10, 50, 100)),
                          type = "response")) |> mutate(species = sp_name),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

extract_slopes <- function(mod, sp_name) {
  tryCatch(
    as.data.frame(emtrends(mod, ~ color, var = "intensity")) |>
      mutate(species = sp_name),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

extract_color_main <- function(mod, sp_name) {
  tryCatch(
    as.data.frame(emmeans(mod, ~ color, type = "response")) |>
      mutate(species = sp_name),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

df_sp_ci    <- map2_dfr(sp_models, names(sp_models), extract_color_intensity)
df_slopes   <- map2_dfr(sp_models, names(sp_models), extract_slopes)
df_sp_color <- map2_dfr(sp_models, names(sp_models), extract_color_main)
```

# Distance-project bat framework (overall, guild, community-average, GAM)

Ports the bat modelling framework from the distance project to the Colter Bay red/white experiment. Distance terms are omitted (there is no gradient here); the treatment predictor is light **colour × intensity** (intensity continuous, 10–100%), with season (`jd`, `jd²`), moon phase, habitat (`pct_nonforest`), and sky brightness, plus **site and year random effects**.

**Year is modelled as a random effect `(1|year)` and the switching-interval term is dropped.** Each year ran a single fixed switching design (3-day: 2019/2022/2024; 7-day: 2020; red-75 control: 2021/2023), so switching is a *function of year* — a `(1|year)` effect subsumes it, fits far better (ΔAIC ≈ 149 vs. a 3/7/year block term), and avoids inflating the intensity effect by under-adjusting.

**Confounding caveat.** The intensity *scheme* also varied by year (low intensities 10/30/50 only in 2022/2024; 95% only in 2020; red-75 in the 2021/2023 controls), so intensity is partly confounded with year across the full dataset. This all-years model is therefore best read as a **year-adjusted overview**; the clean within-design intensity experiment is **2022 + 2024** (both balanced 10/30/50/70/100, both colours, same design). Call-frequency guilds follow the distance project: **Low** = Epfu/Lano/Laci, **Myev**, **High** = Mylu/Myvo/Myci/Myyu.

```{r cb_aggregations, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
lowfreq_spp  <- c("Epfu", "Lano", "Laci")
medfreq_spp  <- c("Myev")
highfreq_spp <- c("Mylu", "Myvo", "Myci", "Myyu")
focal_spp    <- c(lowfreq_spp, medfreq_spp, highfreq_spp)

bat_env <- data_env %>%
  mutate(
    guild = case_when(
      species %in% lowfreq_spp  ~ "LowFreq",
      species %in% medfreq_spp  ~ "Myev",
      species %in% highfreq_spp ~ "HighFreq",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    year_f = factor(year)
  )

# one covariate row per site-night (colour/intensity are per date; habitat/brightness per site)
sn_cov <- bat_env %>%
  group_by(site, year_f, date) %>%
  summarise(color = first(color), intensity = first(intensity), jd = first(jd),
            mean_phase = first(mean_phase), pct_nonforest = first(pct_nonforest),
            mean_brightness_site = first(mean_brightness_site),
            switching_interval = first(switching_interval), .groups = "drop")

# site-night totals, zero-filled guild-nights, zero-filled species-nights
site_night <- bat_env %>%
  group_by(site, year_f, date) %>%
  summarise(total_det = sum(detections), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(sn_cov, by = c("site", "year_f", "date"))

cluster_night <- sn_cov %>%
  tidyr::crossing(guild = c("LowFreq", "Myev", "HighFreq")) %>%
  left_join(
    bat_env %>% filter(!is.na(guild)) %>%
      group_by(site, year_f, date, guild) %>%
      summarise(detections = sum(detections), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("site", "year_f", "date", "guild")
  ) %>%
  mutate(detections = tidyr::replace_na(detections, 0),
         guild = factor(guild, levels = c("LowFreq", "Myev", "HighFreq")))

spp_night <- sn_cov %>%
  tidyr::crossing(species = focal_spp) %>%
  left_join(
    bat_env %>% group_by(site, year_f, date, species) %>%
      summarise(detections = sum(detections), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("site", "year_f", "date", "species")
  ) %>%
  mutate(detections = tidyr::replace_na(detections, 0),
         species = factor(species, levels = focal_spp))
```

## Overall, guild, and community-average models

```{r cb_models, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Switching-interval omitted: it is a function of year, so (1|year) subsumes it.
cov_rhs <- "jd + I(jd^2) + mean_phase + pct_nonforest + mean_brightness_site"

# 1) Overall total activity (site-night) = the canonical model from run_models()
#    (same site-night total ~ colour*intensity + covariates + (1|year) + (1|site)).
overall_model <- models$m2

# 2) Call-frequency guild (zero-inflated; guild × intensity, common colour effect)
guild_model <- glmmTMB(
  as.formula(paste("detections ~ guild * intensity + color +", cov_rhs, "+ (1|year_f) + (1|site)")),
  data = cluster_night, ziformula = ~1, family = nbinom2())

# 3) Community-average species (hierarchical: species random intercept)
species_glmm <- glmmTMB(
  as.formula(paste("detections ~ color * intensity +", cov_rhs, "+ (1|year_f) + (1|site) + (1|species)")),
  data = spp_night, ziformula = ~1, family = nbinom2())

# intensity slope (log scale) by colour / guild
emtrends(overall_model, ~ color, var = "intensity")
emtrends(guild_model,   ~ guild, var = "intensity")
emtrends(species_glmm,  ~ color, var = "intensity")
```

```{r cb_model_figs, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=13, fig.height=4.8}
igrid <- seq(10, 100, length.out = 60)
pred_col <- function(m, ttl, ylab) {
  e <- as.data.frame(emmeans(m, ~ color | intensity, at = list(intensity = igrid), type = "response")) %>%
    rename(lo = asymp.LCL, hi = asymp.UCL)
  ggplot(e, aes(intensity, response, color = color, fill = color)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.12, color = NA) + geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(R = col_red, W = col_white), labels = c(R = "Red", W = "White"), name = "Light colour") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(R = col_red, W = col_white), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = ttl, x = "Intensity (%)", y = ylab) + bat_theme
}
p_overall <- pred_col(overall_model, "Overall total",          "Detections / night")
p_species <- pred_col(species_glmm,  "Community-avg species",   "Detections / species-night")

gcol <- c(LowFreq = "#1B2A4A", Myev = "#6A3D9A", HighFreq = "#B2182B")
e_g <- as.data.frame(emmeans(guild_model, ~ guild | intensity, at = list(intensity = igrid), type = "response")) %>%
  rename(lo = asymp.LCL, hi = asymp.UCL)
p_guild <- ggplot(e_g, aes(intensity, response, color = guild, fill = guild)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.10, color = NA) + geom_line(linewidth = 1) + scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = gcol, name = "Guild") + scale_fill_manual(values = gcol, guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Guild model", x = "Intensity (%)", y = "Detections / guild-night (log)") + bat_theme

(p_overall | p_guild | p_species) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Bats — colour × intensity: three models",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")))
```

## Clean intensity experiment (2022 + 2024)

The all-years model above is a year-adjusted *overview*, but intensity is partly confounded with year there. **2022 and 2024 are the only two years that ran the balanced 10/30/50/70/100 design with both colours under the same (3-day) switching** — so this is the trustworthy within-design test of the intensity response. Intensity is treated as a 5-level factor (so a mid-intensity peak isn't forced into a line), with year as a blocking factor.

```{r cb_clean_years, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=8.5, fig.height=5.5}
clean <- site_night %>%
  filter(year_f %in% c("2022", "2024")) %>%
  mutate(int5 = factor(intensity, levels = c(10, 30, 50, 70, 100)),
         site = factor(site), year_f = droplevels(year_f))

clean_model <- glmmTMB(
  total_det ~ color * int5 + year_f + jd + I(jd^2) + mean_phase +
    pct_nonforest + mean_brightness_site + (1 | site),
  data = clean, family = nbinom2())

# predicted detections by intensity level + White-vs-Red contrast per level
e_clean <- as.data.frame(emmeans(clean_model, ~ color | int5, type = "response")) %>%
  mutate(int5 = factor(int5, levels = c(10, 30, 50, 70, 100)))
ct_clean <- as.data.frame(contrast(emmeans(clean_model, ~ color | int5, type = "response"),
                                    method = "revpairwise"))
print(ct_clean %>% transmute(intensity = as.character(int5),
                             White_vs_Red = round(ratio, 2), p = round(p.value, 3)))

stars <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "***", ifelse(p < .01, "**", ifelse(p < .05, "*", "")))
st <- tibble(int5 = factor(ct_clean$int5, levels = c(10, 30, 50, 70, 100)),
             lab  = stars(ct_clean$p.value))

ggplot(e_clean, aes(int5, response, color = color, group = color)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6, position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL), width = 0.16,
                position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
  geom_text(data = st, aes(x = int5, y = Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            vjust = 1.4, size = 4.6, color = "#111111") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(R = col_red, W = col_white),
                     labels = c(R = "Red", W = "White"), name = "Light colour") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.16))) +
  labs(title = "Clean intensity experiment: 2022 + 2024 (balanced design)",
       subtitle = "Both colours peak at 50%; bats avoid bright red (White >> Red at 100%). Asterisks: White vs Red.",
       x = "Intensity (%)", y = "Predicted detections / night") +
  bat_theme
```

## Overall bat activity: intensity × colour GAM

```{r cb_gam, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
library(mgcv)
gam_dat <- site_night %>% filter(!is.na(intensity), !is.na(color)) %>% mutate(site = factor(site))
bat_gam <- gam(
  total_det ~ color + year_f + s(intensity, by = color, k = 5) + s(jd, k = 5) +
    mean_phase + pct_nonforest + mean_brightness_site + s(site, bs = "re"),
  data = gam_dat, family = nb(), method = "REML")
summary(bat_gam)$s.table

pg <- expand_grid(intensity = seq(10, 100, 1),
                  color = factor(c("R", "W"), levels = levels(gam_dat$color))) %>%
  mutate(jd = median(gam_dat$jd), mean_phase = mean(gam_dat$mean_phase, na.rm = TRUE),
         pct_nonforest = mean(gam_dat$pct_nonforest, na.rm = TRUE),
         mean_brightness_site = mean(gam_dat$mean_brightness_site, na.rm = TRUE),
         year_f = gam_dat$year_f[1], site = gam_dat$site[1])
pr <- predict(bat_gam, newdata = pg, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE, exclude = "s(site)")
il <- family(bat_gam)$linkinv
pg <- pg %>% mutate(fit = il(pr$fit), lo = il(pr$fit - 1.96 * pr$se.fit), hi = il(pr$fit + 1.96 * pr$se.fit))
ggplot(pg, aes(intensity, fit, color = color, fill = color)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) + geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(R = col_red, W = col_white), labels = c(R = "Red", W = "White"), name = "Light colour") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(R = col_red, W = col_white), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Overall bat activity vs intensity (GAM)", x = "Intensity (%)",
       y = "Predicted detections / night") + bat_theme
```

## Data-integrity sanity checks (bats)

```{r cb_sanity_checks, warning=FALSE, message=TRUE}
stopifnot(
  "site-night totals are non-negative integers" =
    all(site_night$total_det >= 0 & site_night$total_det == floor(site_night$total_det)),
  "guild grid has all three guilds per site-night" =
    all(table(cluster_night$guild) == nrow(sn_cov)),
  "species grid zero-filled for all focal species" =
    all(focal_spp %in% levels(spp_night$species)) && nlevels(spp_night$species) == length(focal_spp),
  "intensity within 10-100%" =
    all(site_night$intensity >= 10 & site_night$intensity <= 100, na.rm = TRUE),
  "colours are R/W only" =
    all(as.character(site_night$color) %in% c("R", "W")),
  "no missing model covariates" =
    all(!is.na(site_night$mean_brightness_site)),
  "year has multiple levels for (1|year)" =
    dplyr::n_distinct(site_night$year_f) >= 2
)
message("Bat sanity checks passed: ", nrow(site_night), " site-nights, ",
        length(focal_spp), " focal species across ",
        dplyr::n_distinct(site_night$site), " sites and ",
        dplyr::n_distinct(site_night$year_f), " years.")
```
